description: Transcribe speech from any public audio URL (MP3/WAV/M4A/OGG/WebM/FLAC, max 15 MB) via Whisper Large v3 Turbo with optional timestamps. $0.005 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

language.description: optional 2-letter ISO language hint (e.g. en, de)

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.
